_comment: scripts/calibration_shadow_harness.py (operator design 2026-10-22). Evaluates each PROPOSED signal_calibration threshold beside the current one over the next `sessions` forward sessions. Recommendations are proposals; the operator ratifies (AGENTS.md §17). current_values: the CURRENT production value of a knob the operator has not set in config/scalp_signal_engine.yaml (a set value there wins). Changed by reviewed PR only.
_current_values: The engine defaults in scripts/active_trader/momentum_alerts.AlertConfig, read under execution-engineering grant e88bf21e (2026-10-22). The harness lane does not import the broker execution set; tests/test_calibration_shadow_harness_20261022.py pins these equal to AlertConfig so a change there turns the test red.
_current_scale: Multiplier from a knob's config units to its journal feature's units. min_stop.pct_of_price is a fraction of price (0.01 = 1%); the journal feature risk_pct is a percent. signal_calibration now proposes in knob units with proposed_feature_value beside it (KNOB_UNIT_SCALE, 2026-10-22 unit fix); the harness compares in feature units.
